newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM Cargo to set up route planning unit April 1.
newsitem.headline: KLM Cargo to set up route planning unit April 1.

text.p: KLM Cargo, the airfreight wing of KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV, aims to establish by April 1 a new business unit responsible for route planning and sales, a spokesman said.

In a telephone interview with Reuters, Peter Wellhuner said KLM Cargo's management is still assessing how large the new unit will be. It will draw staff and resources from the cargo division's five existing business units and by April 1 decisions will be taken on the numbers involved.
The new unit will have two principle tasks - organising the KLM Cargo's route network and selling its airfreight products internationally.
The division, to be called Business Unit Rederij, does not have an easy translation in English. "We know what it means, but it does not translate well," the spokesman said.
The unit will take its place alongside KLM Cargo's five other business units, which are special cargo, air mail, logistics Information Technology, and Cargo Service Centres, he added.
